name: ServiceOffering
description: Defines a service offering with tiered pricing, service groups, option groups, and facet-based targeting.

global.schema:
type ServiceOfferingState {
    id: PHID!
    operatorId: PHID!
    resourceTemplateId: PHID
    title: String!
    summary: String!
    description: String
    thumbnailUrl: URL
    infoLink: URL
    status: ServiceStatus!
    lastModified: DateTime!
    availableBillingCycles: [BillingCycle!]!
    facetTargets: [FacetTarget!]!
    services: [Service!]!
    tiers: [ServiceSubscriptionTier!]!
    optionGroups: [OptionGroup!]!
}

enum ServiceStatus {
    DRAFT
    COMING_SOON
    ACTIVE
    DEPRECATED
}

enum BillingCycle {
    MONTHLY
    QUARTERLY
    SEMI_ANNUAL
    ANNUAL
}

type FacetTarget {
    id: OID!
    categoryKey: String!
    categoryLabel: String!
    selectedOptions: [String!]!
}

type Service {
    id: OID!
    title: String!
    description: String
    displayOrder: Int
    isSetupFormation: Boolean!
    optionGroupId: OID
}

type ServiceSubscriptionTier {
    id: OID!
    name: String!
    description: String
    isCustomPricing: Boolean!
    pricingMode: TierPricingMode!
    pricing: TierPricing
    defaultBillingCycle: BillingCycle
    billingCycleDiscounts: [BillingCycleDiscount!]!
    serviceLevels: [TierServiceLevel!]!
    usageLimits: [UsageLimit!]!
}

enum TierPricingMode {
    FIXED
    PER_SEAT
    CUSTOM
}

type TierPricing {
    amount: Amount_Money!
    currency: Currency!
}

type BillingCycleDiscount {
    cycle: BillingCycle!
    discountType: DiscountType!
    discountValue: Float!
}

enum DiscountType {
    PERCENTAGE
    FIXED_AMOUNT
}

type TierServiceLevel {
    id: OID!
    serviceId: OID!
    level: String!
    description: String
}

type UsageLimit {
    id: OID!
    name: String!
    limit: Int!
    unit: String
}

type OptionGroup {
    id: OID!
    name: String!
    description: String
    isAddOn: Boolean!
    defaultSelected: Boolean!
    pricingMode: AddOnPricingMode!
    standalonePricing: TierPricing
    tierDependentPricing: [TierDependentPricing!]!
    costType: GroupCostType
    availableBillingCycles: [BillingCycle!]!
    billingCycleDiscounts: [BillingCycleDiscount!]!
    discountMode: DiscountMode
    price: Amount_Money
    currency: Currency
}

enum AddOnPricingMode {
    STANDALONE
    TIER_DEPENDENT
}

enum GroupCostType {
    SETUP
    RECURRING
}

enum DiscountMode {
    OWN_DISCOUNTS
    INHERIT_TIER
}

type TierDependentPricing {
    tierId: OID!
    amount: Amount_Money!
    currency: Currency!
}

modules.name: Offering
modules.description: Operations for managing offering metadata and facet targeting

operations.name: UPDATE_OFFERING_INFO
operations.schema:
input UpdateOfferingInfoInput {
    title: String
    summary: String
    description: String
    thumbnailUrl: URL
    infoLink: URL
    lastModified: DateTime!
}

operations.name: UPDATE_OFFERING_STATUS
operations.reducer:
state.status = action.input.status;
state.lastModified = action.input.lastModified;

operations.name: SET_OPERATOR
operations.reducer:
state.operatorId = action.input.operatorId;
state.lastModified = action.input.lastModified;

operations.name: SET_OFFERING_ID
operations.reducer:
state.id = action.input.id;
state.lastModified = action.input.lastModified;

operations.name: SET_FACET_TARGET
operations.schema:
input SetFacetTargetInput {
    id: OID!
    categoryKey: String!
    categoryLabel: String!
    selectedOptions: [String!]!
    lastModified: DateTime!
}

operations.name: REMOVE_FACET_TARGET
ADD_FACET_OPTION
REMOVE_FACET_OPTION
SELECT_RESOURCE_TEMPLATE
operations.reducer:
state.resourceTemplateId = action.input.resourceTemplateId;
state.lastModified = action.input.lastModified;

operations.name: CHANGE_RESOURCE_TEMPLATE
operations.reducer:
state.resourceTemplateId = action.input.resourceTemplateId;
state.lastModified = action.input.lastModified;

operations.name: SET_AVAILABLE_BILLING_CYCLES
operations.reducer:
state.availableBillingCycles = action.input.billingCycles;
state.lastModified = action.input.lastModified;

operations.name: ADD_SERVICE
operations.schema:
input AddServiceInput {
    id: OID!
    title: String!
    description: String
    displayOrder: Int
    isSetupFormation: Boolean
    optionGroupId: OID
    lastModified: DateTime!
}
operations.reducer:
state.services.push({ id: action.input.id, title: action.input.title, description: action.input.description || null, displayOrder: action.input.displayOrder || null, isSetupFormation: action.input.isSetupFormation || false, optionGroupId: action.input.optionGroupId || null });
state.lastModified = action.input.lastModified;

operations.name: UPDATE_SERVICE
operations.schema:
input UpdateServiceInput {
    id: OID!
    title: String
    description: String
    displayOrder: Int
    isSetupFormation: Boolean
    optionGroupId: OID
    lastModified: DateTime!
}

operations.name: DELETE_SERVICE
ADD_TIER
operations.schema:
input AddTierInput {
    id: OID!
    name: String!
    description: String
    isCustomPricing: Boolean
    lastModified: DateTime!
}
operations.reducer:
state.tiers.push({ id: action.input.id, name: action.input.name, description: action.input.description || null, isCustomPricing: action.input.isCustomPricing || false, pricingMode: "FIXED", pricing: null, defaultBillingCycle: null, billingCycleDiscounts: [], serviceLevels: [], usageLimits: [] });
state.lastModified = action.input.lastModified;

input UpdateTierInput {
